eras.note: Virginia Senate elections are held in odd years on 4-year terms — not on the 2026 ballot (next: 2027, same as the House due to the 2021 mapping cycle). First used in 2023. Veto override is 2/3 of members present (must include a majority of elected members) — the seat figure here assumes full attendance.
